copy.headline: Notre Dame loses safety Talich to injury during SMU's opening drive
copy.caption: Notre Dame starting safety Luke Talich left the Fighting Irish's game against SMU in the first quarter with an apparent right leg injury suffered on the opening drive of the game Saturday night in South Bend, Indiana.
